original_test_intent: Verify every approved firmware/BIOS readiness record across IB SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web against the versioned firmware recipe and readiness-state semantics.
original_method: Enumerate exact Ready and BIOS-related records rather than executing the ambiguous shell text; bind each record to a firmware component and version; retain complete aligned IB/OOB inventories and Web context; compare record type, raw/decoded state, component/version dependency and freshness without updating or resetting firmware.
manual_activity: The owner defines readiness records, component/version dependencies and acceptable states, resolves the filter and criteria 3–104; an operator reviews Web context, then the owner decides the verdict.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/BIOS and all relevant firmware identities
Exact readiness record names, IDs/types and component ownership
Versioned firmware recipe and component dependency/activation-state map
Raw-to-decoded ready/not-ready/error state rules and freshness tolerance
IB/OOB/Web aliases and complete Web/API access
Protected credentials, filter correction and criteria 3–104 decision
safety_requirements: Use read-only status and inventory queries with protected credentials
Do not update, reset, activate, roll back or reconfigure firmware/BIOS
Do not execute `grep Ready and BIOS` as an AND expression
Do not use the item title as a sensor or truncate evidence
Stop on not-ready/error state, version mismatch, missing/stale record or channel disagreement
agent_execution_scope: Verify the unique source and collect complete passive IB/OOB readiness inventories
Map each approved record to component/version and decode state
Complete Web parity and report missing/extra/stale/version mismatches
Preserve not-ready evidence without retry or remediation
Perform no firmware action, filter decision, criteria invention or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve readiness population, component/version recipe and state decoder
Replace or explain the ambiguous filter and resolve criteria gap
Review all readiness evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool is relevant, but `sensor get 'Check FW Ready'` invents an aggregate record and the head-limited fallback cannot establish the exact readiness population or Web/version context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely retain full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, exact-match each owner-approved readiness record independently, capture corresponding Web/firmware inventory context and compare through the component/version recipe.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The literal Ready/BIOS source terms, both IB/OOB lists, Web, SPEC comparison, Config-Check and 3/0-minute values remain; ambiguous syntax is not executed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a per-component readiness matrix containing active/staged version, dependency state, raw/decoded readiness and timestamp across IB/OOB/Web.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces ambiguous text filtering with exact record identity while remaining read-only.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A single synthetic ready value can hide one not-ready component or a version/dependency mismatch.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Readiness may change during initialization and different surfaces may cache it; approved timing and state-transition windows are required.

project_override_considerations: If readiness is intentionally aggregated, the owner must define its component coverage and failure propagation. No firmware action may be introduced to force a ready state in this row.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and ambiguous-filter/criteria defect record
Versioned component inventory, firmware recipe, dependency map and readiness decoder
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor/status lists with timestamps/exits
Every approved readiness record, component/version mapping and corresponding Web context
Missing/stale/version/dependency analysis, no-update/no-reset/no-clear audit, criteria decision and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: `grep Ready and BIOS` does not implement a reliable two-term match, exact records and component/version semantics are undefined, and criteria jump from 2 to 105. DeepSeek invents one aggregate sensor and truncates evidence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Passive collection is feasible; record population, recipe, decoding and source clarification are supplyable owner inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2040 Wistron-BMC-01059-V002: define the exact Ready/BIOS readiness records, firmware components, active/staged versions, dependencies and acceptable raw/decoded states; replace or explain `grep Ready and BIOS`; and confirm whether Criteria 1, 2, 105 is only misnumbered or Criteria 3–104 are missing.

review_improvement: Expands readiness to explicit components and versions, rejects invalid shell semantics and aggregate/truncated evidence, and prevents any update/reset from obscuring a not-ready state.
independent_technical_reasoning: In a shell pipeline, words after the grep pattern are treated as file arguments rather than a logical conjunction, so the source command cannot prove both Ready and BIOS. Firmware readiness is also component- and version-dependent; one ready bit can coexist with another component being staged, initializing or failed. Exact record identity and versioned dependency evidence are therefore required.
